name: Toorisugari ga Nakayoku Naru made
original_name: 通りすがりが仲良くなるまで
source: It’s a story that takes place over about two months, beginning when the protagonist, who has moved to a quiet countryside, meets a girl at a bus stop on his way to work. At first, she’s very cautious, but through small interactions each time they pass by, their relationship gradually deepens.
translation: 这是一个发生在两个月左右的故事，故事开始于搬到安静乡村的主人公在上班途中在公交车站遇见了一个女孩。起初，她很谨慎，但通过每次路过的小互动，两人的关系逐渐加深。
